title: Builder's Drink
description: Drinks that give you an advantage in many aspects
body:
This mod comes with drinks that provide many advantages but are difficult to make. The mod is in development phase and there may be some errors, I am aware that the textures look bad and it will be fixed soon. and the cover photo of the mod will be changed

Some Recipes:

![RecipeOfBottleOfBuilder'sDrink](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab08a1665bff21073ab7fdd51443da8f473568ef.png)


![RecipeOfBuilder'sDrink](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79e22d332534b02d6d6705083d2fc12e2c770d24.png)




Details: 
builder's drink requires yellow dye, a glowing squid, a rabbit's foot, and the heart of the sea 
Builder's drink gives Dolphin's Grace, Night Vision, Haste and Speed
